for_the_later_review: how this is put before a human reviewer (which witness or witnesses, blinded or not, with which questions) is a faculty decision that is pending; no review set and no screen were built

hemodynamics.note: the snapshot the live development authority runs; it is read, never changed

limitations: the three witnesses are probes of a region whose every magnitude has a confidence below 0.80: none is a calibration
the support adds no volume and recruits no venous return: in a bleeding patient the pressure it buys keeps falling with the bleed
output and delivery never rise with tone here: the afterload is the only path from tone to flow
only the encounter's first norepinephrine order is mapped, and only as a start at a fixed rate in mcg/min; an adjustment, a stop, a weight-based dose and any later start are declared gaps
the consciousness reading is taken from the pressure: with the support it reads better while delivery is lower (see the probes record)
shadow only: nothing here is authoritative, shown to a resident or scored

declared_gaps.another_operation: norepinephrine {operation} has no core mapping: only a start at a fixed rate is mapped (no titration and no stop)
declared_gaps.any_order_after_an_unmapped_first: the encounter's first norepinephrine order was not mapped, so the run does not mirror its vasopressor and maps no later order of the kind either
declared_gaps.any_order_after_the_first: norepinephrine {operation} after the run's infusion started is not mapped (no titration, no stop, no restart): the run keeps the infusion it mapped and, from this order on, no longer mirrors the encounter's vasopressor
declared_gaps.no_rate: a norepinephrine start without a finite positive rate is not mapped
declared_gaps.other_units: norepinephrine in {units} is not mapped: only a fixed rate in mcg/min (a weight-based dose needs a weight this mapping does not read)

not_shown.comparator: none: the legacy engine's pressure under norepinephrine is a fixed bonus in mmHg, the form this pathway forbids
not_shown.heart_rate_and_capillary_refill: not part of the candidate: the common core's are not authoritative, and the legacy engine's were computed under its own vasopressor rule, which this pathway does not use

gaps.why: no core intervention for this order type yet

order_not_mapped.what: the same run with the order left as the declared gap it was before this stage: what the bleed does to the pressure with no vasopressor in the core

scenario.script_note: the certified run's two-minute history question is two minutes of clinical time here (a reassessment): a question carries no physiology, so the common core sees the same thing; the two later reassessments are new, because the certified run stopped at the order

turns.text: Start norepinephrine at 10 mcg/min. Reassess in 5 minutes.

statement: Synthetic development cases run in the shadow. Development probes of a behavioural region: not a clinical validation, not a calibration, not a dose-response, not runtime authority and not visible to a resident. No witness is chosen.

the_certified_run_is_untouched.still_true_of_the_live_authority: norepinephrine is not a supported authority action and the live grant names it as not granted
the_certified_run_is_untouched.what: FR-F as certified: the live GI pressure development authority stops on the order (HALTED_BY_UNSUPPORTED_ACTION)

what_it_is: FR-F with its norepinephrine order mapped in the SHADOW to the common vasoconstrictor support of PHASE2_AMENDMENT_3, on the ratified GI pressure snapshot, once per witness of the development region. What a later human review would look at; it decides nothing.
